_help: AIR Career Program (seen 2026-10-12). Four careers, each 750 career points (CP) to graduate; overall 3,000 CP. Sub-goals are bubbles inside each career. Edit from screenshots.

Soldier of Fortune.note: 35 CP = 30 from three missions + 5 from Destruction 1/5 (so Destruction goals likely give 5 CP each). Bubble rewards other than Career Agent Missions not seen yet. Goal list seen 2026-10-12; career points per goal NOT seen (hover one goal bubble). Social goals are one-click cheap: chat message, add contact, EVE mail, join fleet; 'Join a Corporation' changes your corp, do not do it blindly.
